subject: Post-demo: model evals and multilingual checklist (EU + APAC)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@globex-retail.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@globex-retail.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 15:02:00 -0500
Subject: Post-demo: model evals and multilingual checklist (EU + APAC)

Hi Emma / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the demo today — really appreciate the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can move to a focused eval: 

Recap from our call:
- Goal: Evaluate candidate models for customer-facing conversational flows and localized product descriptions across EU and APAC locales (FR/DE/ES + JA/KO).
- Primary constraints: EU data residency requirements for EU customers, tone/localization consistency for APAC markets, and strict PII handling.
- Success metrics you called out: intent accuracy, hallucination rate on product facts, and a human-evaluated NPS-style quality score per locale.

Recommended initial model candidates for evaluation:
- redwood-2-large (our baseline for production-grade latency/quality)
- LlamaX-7B-q4 (cost-efficient variant for lower-latency paths)
- mT5-large (strong multilingual baseline for translation-sensitive outputs)

What we plan to deliver in the eval (attached spec + prompt sets):
1) Per-language automated metrics (BLEU/chrF where applicable, intent accuracy, extraction F1)
2) Small human eval (native speakers) for tone and cultural appropriateness (we'll run a 30-min calibration session together)
3) Regression checks vs. your existing production baseline (if available)

Attachments: multilingual_eval_spec.pdf, prompt_sets_v1.zip (sample prompts for FR/DE/ES/JA/KO).

Next steps (proposed):
- Confirm a 2-week evaluation window and provide a ~500-row sample dataset (de-identified) per language (or confirm we can sample from your QA set).
- Confirm whether EU data must remain in EU-hosted infrastructure (we can run the eval on EU-only nodes if required).
- Schedule a 30-minute calibration call with your localization SMEs (suggest Tue/Wed next week).

If that all sounds good I'll kick off the eval and share a results dashboard + raw metrics by the end of the window.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference


From: Emma Li <emma.li@globex-retail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@globex-retail.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo: model evals and multilingual checklist (EU + APAC)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the attachments — very helpful. A few clarifying notes from our side before we sign off on the sample: 

1) Data residency: For EU customers we do need data processing to be within the EU. Can you confirm if the eval can run exclusively on EU-hosted infra and that no PII leaves the region?
2) Metrics: for JA/KO we don't use BLEU much; we'll want to focus on semantic accuracy and native-speaker quality judgments. Can you include a custom human-eval rubric for those languages?
3) Timeline: 2-week window is fine. We can give you de-identified QA extracts by EOD Wednesday.
4) Security/compliance: can you share your SOC 2 report and your data retention policy for eval artifacts? If possible please add to the Drive link.

Also looping in Tom — he'll coordinate our localization SMEs for the calibration call.

Appreciate it —
Emma Li
Head of Localization, Globex Retail
emma.li@globex-retail.com


From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Post-demo: model evals and multilingual checklist (internal)

Marissa / Steph — quick internal note on approach and risks: 

- EU residency: We can run the full eval on our EU cluster. Need to ensure the dataset host is EU. Ops will provision a temporary EU-only project (no backups replicated to non-EU). I'll open an infra ticket.
- Model choices: run redwood-2-large as primary. For cost/perf tradeoffs include LlamaX-7B-q4 and mT5-large. For JA/KO, run semantic similarity scoring (SBERT multilingual) and include human pairwise comparisons instead of BLEU.
- Regression detection: run a before/after diff against your baseline if they can provide 200 examples per language; we'll run automatic regression alerts (thresholds set to 5% drop in intent accuracy or 10-pt drop in human quality score).
- Ops: I'll provide a shared dashboard link and a minimal results spreadsheet (multilingual_eval_results_summary.xlsx).

I'll coordinate with Ops to get the EU project up today — Steph, can you draft the human-eval rubric for JA/KO and FR/DE/ES? Make sure to include tone and local idiom checks.

Thanks —
Mike
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference


From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@globex-retail.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@globex-retail.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 10:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-demo: model evals and multilingual checklist (EU + APAC)

Hi Emma / Tom —

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming next steps and links: 

1) Data residency: confirmed — we will run the eval on EU-only infra for the EU samples. No eval artifacts will be replicated outside the EU project.
2) Sample delivery: please share the de-identified QA extracts (500 rows per language recommended) by EOD Wednesday. If you prefer, we can pull a sample via a secure SharePoint link instead.
3) Human-eval rubric: attached (prompt_sets_v1.zip contains sample prompts; we've also attached a draft rubric for JA/KO and FR/DE/ES). Stephanie will run a short calibration session with your SMEs during the 30-min call.
4) Dashboard & artifacts: results dashboard (view-only) — https://drive.redwood.company/shared/multilingual-evals/GLOBEX-2027-0342. We'll drop the SOC 2 report and the eval summary spreadsheet there (multilingual_eval_results_summary.xlsx).

Proposed schedule: Calibration call — Thu 17 Feb, 09:00 CET / 17:00 SGT (30 min). Please confirm availability and who from your localization team will attend.

If we get the samples Wednesday morning we'll aim to return interim automated metrics by next Tuesday and full human-eval + regression report at the end of the 2-week window.

Thanks — looking forward to this.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: prompt_sets_v1.zip; multilingual_eval_results_summary.xlsx; multilingual_eval_spec.pdf
